apps.name: Soirée Crew
apps.subtitle: Ta soirée, ton crew, ton taux.
apps.localizedDescription: Note tes verres et vois ton taux estimé, sa courbe et l'heure du retour à zéro. Sors avec ton crew : soirées, bars, jeux, chat, cagnottes et récap du lendemain. Estimation, pas un éthylotest : ne prends jamais le volant sur cette base.

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to check in at a bar with your crew, and to share it during a party if you turn that on. It is checked, then deleted.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Your photos fill the party album, seen by your crew only. Their location is removed.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera takes photos for the party album and your chats, and scans a friend's safety code. Photos are seen only by the people you share them with.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voice notes in your chats use the microphone, only while you record one. They are encrypted on your phone before they are sent.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: The calendar gets the parties you add to it, nothing else is read.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Keep AltStore history optional and explain API compatibility changes
• Publish separate public and Preview apps in AltStore, retain downloadable history and refine screen spacing
• Keep compact dashboard sections in normal flow and bound the drink form on iPad
• Build a native iPad interface with adaptive navigation, dashboard, map panes and game grids
• Keep server configuration available while bundling native apps
• Reserve a separate network budget for signed photo galleries
• Add guest public browsing, bounded caches, shared-network quotas and iPad IPA checks
• Fix stale map responses, removed crew selection and web screen remounts
• Improve the bars map and social venue discovery
• Bars map: my position dot and locate button; tapped bar shows ranking, my nights and photos
• Button: no vertical padding, all buttons keep the same height; short labels fit on one line
• Revert Button vertical padding: all buttons keep the same height, short labels fit on one line
• Button: vertical padding so a two-line label is not tight against the border
• Shorter label for withdrawing the health consent so it stays on one line
• No-account dot: pink instead of cyan, which the anti-slop lint (D-09) refuses
• Moi tab: a cyan dot while there is no account
• Every screen needs the arrival flow first: direct URLs redirect to onboarding
• Moi: guests get a row to create or open an account
• Web: screen blocks rise in once, then drop their animated style
• Web: no rise-in animation on screen blocks, it left blank holes after scrolling
• Guests can create or open an account; sign-out asks to confirm and needs a password
• Fix onboarding progress row overlapping the step title
• Let guests into the app after onboarding: age is optional
• Preview deployment
